transliteration: kākaṇyādis tv arthadaṇḍaḥ sarvasvāntas tathaiva ca | śārīras tv avarodhādir jīvitāntas tathaiva ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Injury to external objects results in financial restitution up to total assets; bodily harm necessitates restraint or life-endangering consequences.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity to protect and sustain creation
Causation is determined by direct ontological disruption
Responsibility aligns with the degree of existential threat posed
Restoration logic requires proportional energetic completion
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of inviolable boundaries
executable_legal_axioms: IF action disrupts another's property THEN enforce full economic compensation up to perpetrator’s total assets
IF bodily integrity is violated THEN initiate containment protocols OR invoke life-preserving cessation measures
IF no intent but damage occurs THEN assign corrective completion process aligned with causal field restoration
IF intent escalates violation THEN activate consciousness-realignment protocol prior to structural enforcement
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority must distinguish between material loss and existential breach. Material restitution operates within asset-liability frameworks. Bodily violations require immediate threshold assessment—determining whether containment or life-altering intervention is mandated without punitive inference.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through observed disruption sequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that uncontrolled actions manifest predictable outcomes. Responsibility is calibrated not for suffering but for completion. There is no punishment—only alignment with natural consequence for restoration of dharma-field integrity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset-based restitution cycle until balance is restored
Deploy physical boundary maintenance systems to prevent recurrence
Assign perpetrator a completion task tied to damaged domain
Activate group-consciousness witnessing to realign disruptive patterns
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious completion, not punitive enforcement. All actions resolve in alignment with universal integrity, under the sole adjudication of awakened consciousness.
